citation: Stupp et al. Eur J Cancer. 2012
design: Open-label randomized phase III active-control trial
intervention: TTFields monotherapy; target use about 20-24 h/day
primary_result: Published paper: median OS 6.6 vs 6.0 months; HR 0.86 (95% CI 0.66-1.12), P=.27
secondary_result: PFS at 6 months 21.4% vs 15.1%, P=.13; 1-year survival 20% in both arms
safety_or_burden: TTFields-related skin reactions mainly mild/moderate; severe adverse events less frequent in TTFields arm in publication
key_strengths: Randomized phase III; active comparator; clinical endpoint and tolerability assessment
key_limitations: Open label; varied physician-choice comparator; no statistically significant OS advantage; FDA SSED numerical estimate differs
interpretation: Primary publication does not demonstrate OS superiority. Keep published estimate separate from FDA SSED estimate pending reconciliation.
verification_status: Publication verified; numerical discrepancy versus FDA SSED flagged

design: FDA regulatory review of randomized pivotal trial
primary_result: FDA SSED: median OS 6.3 vs 6.4 months; HR 1.0, P=.98
safety_or_burden: FDA review describes fewer adverse events overall and device-related scalp skin reactions
key_strengths: Primary regulatory source; summarizes trial submitted with PMA
key_limitations: Numerical OS estimate differs from 2012 journal article; underlying analysis set/time origin/statistical approach require reconciliation
interpretation: Both FDA SSED and published article do not establish statistically significant OS advantage; do not silently combine estimates.
verification_status: FDA source verified; discrepancy investigation remains open

setting: Newly diagnosed GBM after standard chemoradiotherapy
design: Open-label randomized phase III multicenter trial; 2:1 allocation
intervention: TTFields plus maintenance temozolomide; intended prolonged daily use
primary_result: Median PFS from randomization 6.7 vs 4.0 months; HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.52-0.76), P<.001
secondary_result: Median OS from randomization 20.9 vs 16.0 months; HR 0.63 (95% CI 0.53-0.76), P<.001; median follow-up 44 months
safety_or_burden: Systemic AE frequency 48% vs 44%; mild/moderate array-site skin toxicity 52%, grade 3 skin involvement 2% in TTFields group
key_strengths: Randomized phase III; 83 centers; blinded independent central MRI review; PFS and OS effects reported
key_limitations: Open label; device burden cannot be blinded; post-chemoradiotherapy population is selected; generalizability depends on patient characteristics and practice context
interpretation: Supports benefit for TTFields plus maintenance TMZ in this specific newly diagnosed setting; do not generalize to recurrent monotherapy or every treatment context.

design: Secondary HRQoL analysis of randomized EF-14 trial
intervention: TTFields plus temozolomide arm in EF-14
endpoint_hierarchy: HRQoL secondary endpoints; deterioration-free survival/time to deterioration
primary_result: HRQoL did not significantly differ between arms across domains except itchy skin; 639/695 completed baseline questionnaire
secondary_result: Deterioration-free survival longer for global health, physical/emotional functioning, pain, and leg weakness; likely related to longer PFS
safety_or_burden: More itchy skin with TTFields; no broad negative effect in measured HRQoL domains was identified
key_strengths: Planned HRQoL measures; randomized parent trial; baseline questionnaire completed by 91.9%
key_limitations: Questionnaire completion/attrition over time; secondary analysis; some differences likely reflect PFS duration
interpretation: Supports cautious conclusion of broadly similar measured HRQoL with added scalp symptoms, not a universal improvement in all domains.

setting: Newly diagnosed GBM; post-randomization device-use subgroup
design: Secondary subgroup analysis of compliance within TTFields+TMZ arm versus TMZ-alone arm
intervention: TTFields plus TMZ stratified by monthly device use
endpoint_hierarchy: Exploratory compliance association with PFS and OS
primary_result: At 50% monthly compliance threshold vs TMZ alone: OS HR 0.67 (95% CI 0.45-0.99); PFS HR 0.70 (95% CI 0.47-1.05)
secondary_result: At >90% compliance, reported median survival 24.9 months from randomization (28.7 from diagnosis) and 5-year survival 29.3%
safety_or_burden: Sustained use requires substantial daily device wear and array/scalp management
key_strengths: Uses logged device-use data and adjusted Cox model for selected prognostic variables
key_limitations: Adherence level was not randomized; post-randomization subgroup analysis susceptible to selection, prognosis, and survivorship-related bias; PFS CI crosses 1.0 for stated 50% threshold contrast
interpretation: Higher use is associated with better outcomes but this analysis does not prove causality or establish a universally optimal minimum-use threshold.
verification_status: Primary subgroup-analysis publication verified; causal interpretation explicitly limited
